$comment: GENERATED by `cd backend && python -m codeguard.browser_export` from backend/codeguard. Do not edit: change the Python engine and regenerate.

regex.doc: Compile with new RegExp(pattern, flags). Python's semantics are spelled out in the source (see codeguard/browser_export.py): every spec uses the 'u' flag and never JS's i/m/s flags. 'call' is how Python applies it: 'match' sources are already anchored; add 'g' for findall, finditer, sub and split. Match offsets are UTF-16 indexes, Python's are code points.

python.doc: Python str semantics the engine relies on. strip()/split() use 'whitespace'; splitlines() breaks on 'line_breaks' and treats CR LF as one break; len() and slicing count code points.

rules.title: Dynamic code evaluation (eval)
rules.recommendation: Never evaluate strings as code. Parse data explicitly (JSON.parse / ast.literal_eval).

rules.title: Dynamic code execution (exec)
rules.recommendation: Avoid exec(); replace with explicit dispatch over a fixed set of operations.

rules.title: Function constructor builds code from strings
rules.recommendation: Replace `new Function(...)` with a static function.

rules.title: Unsanitized HTML sink (innerHTML / document.write)
rules.recommendation: Use textContent, or sanitize with DOMPurify before inserting HTML.

rules.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML used
rules.recommendation: Make sure the HTML is sanitized (e.g. DOMPurify.sanitize) before rendering.

rules.title: OS command execution via child_process
rules.recommendation: Use execFile/spawn with an argument array instead of interpolating into a shell string.

rules.title: Shell command with shell=True
rules.recommendation: Pass an argument list and keep shell=False.

rules.title: os.system / os.popen call
rules.recommendation: Use subprocess.run([...]) with an argument list and validated input.

rules.title: Shell execution function
rules.recommendation: Avoid shell functions; if unavoidable, escape with escapeshellarg().

rules.title: SQL built with string concatenation
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.

rules.title: SQL built with string formatting
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries; never interpolate user input into SQL.

rules.title: Weak hash algorithm (MD5/SHA1)
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256+ for integrity, and bcrypt/argon2 for passwords.

rules.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.recommendation: Keep certificate verification on; pin a CA bundle if you need a private CA.

rules.title: CORS allows any origin
rules.recommendation: Restrict CORS to an explicit allow-list of trusted origins.

rules.title: Debug mode enabled
rules.recommendation: Drive debug mode from an environment variable and keep it off in production.

rules.title: Leftover debugger statement
rules.recommendation: Remove debugger statements before shipping.

rules.title: JWT signature verification disabled
rules.recommendation: Always verify JWT signatures with an explicit algorithm allow-list.

rules.title: Unsafe deserialization
rules.recommendation: Use json, or yaml.safe_load; never unpickle untrusted data.

rules.title: Outbound request to a user-controlled URL
rules.recommendation: Validate outbound URLs against an allow-list of hosts.

rules.title: File path built from request input
rules.recommendation: Resolve the path and check it stays inside an allowed base directory.

secrets.recommendation: Revoke and rotate this credential now, then load it from an environment variable or a secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Doppler). Purge it from git history with git filter-repo.
